alteration_nature: synthetic digital alterations (simulated Central Rotation, Z-cut Discontinuity, and Obliteration Scars on digital sensor images; not live physical tissue injuries)

ci_methodology.per_cell: Exact two-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% binomial confidence interval for independent Bernoulli trials.
ci_methodology.aggregate: Two-level subject-clustered bootstrap (B=500 replicates) resampling independent subject clusters with replacement.

naive_legacy_020_warning.note: At T=0.20, FAR is 95.6% (inadequate rejection due to impostor baseline).

preliminary_status_notice: Results on held-out synthetic digital alteration test set are preliminary due to elevated error rates (Fold 1: FRR = 24.4%, FAR = 18.5% at calibrated T_accept = 0.3770, EER = 20.9%; Fold 2: FRR = 15.6%, FAR = 37.0%, EER = 26.7%; Pooled 10-Subject CV: EER = 24.4%, AUC = 0.8304). Confirms synthetic digital alteration degradation pattern: Easy -> Medium -> Hard.

held_out_3x3_cross_tabulation.harmonization_status: Harmonized at benchmark threshold T_accept = 0.3891 (resolves FP=25 vs FP=15 discrepancy; exact row-level sum matches aggregate confusion matrix)
